statement:
For pairwise distinct nonnegative reals \(a, b, c\), prove that
\[\frac{a^2}{(b-c)^2} + \frac{b^2}{(c-a)^2} + \frac{c^2}{(b-a)^2} > 2.\]

A function \(f\) from the positive integers to the positive integers satisfies \(f(f(n)) = \) (number of positive integer divisors of \(n\)) for all \(n\). Prove that if \(p\) is prime, then \(f(p)\) is prime.

Define \(S_n = \{1, 2, \ldots, n\}\). A non-empty subset \(T_n\) of \(S_n\) is called balanced if the average of the elements of \(T_n\) equals the median of \(T_n\). Prove that for all \(n\), the number of balanced subsets of \(S_n\) is odd.

Let \(ABCD\) be a parallelogram. Points \(P\) and \(Q\) lie inside \(ABCD\) such that \(\triangle ABP\) and \(\triangle BCQ\) are equilateral. Prove that the intersection of the line through \(P\) perpendicular to \(PD\) and the line through \(Q\) perpendicular to \(DQ\) lies on the altitude from \(B\) in \(\triangle ABC\).

There are \(100\) circles of radius \(1\) in the plane. Any triangle formed by the centres of three of these circles has area at most \(2017\). Prove that there is a line intersecting at least three of the circles.
